get.description: Get a list of payments sorted by creation date (most recent first)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set. Default is 0.

parameters.description: The numbers of items to return. Default is 50.

parameters.name: created.gte
parameters.description: Return only payments created at or after the specified time. Default is beginning of the current day.

parameters.name: created.lt
parameters.description: If passed, return only payments created strictly before the specified time
